newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Tahran escalates row with Europe, expands cooperation with Russia. A German court has linked Iran to terrorism and said Iranian political leadership ordered the killings of a group of Iranian Kurdish leaders in Berlin in 1992.
- U.S. intelligence says an Iranian officer planned the Khobar bomb blast in which 19 American soldiers were killed.
- Yemen plans to liquidate a second group of losing industrial institutions.
- A Palestinian woman shot and wounded two Israelis in revenge of her relative.
- The governor of the holy city of Mecca opens a power plant in Jeddah built at a cost of 566 million riyals.
- Owners of the regional carrier Gulf Air decide to extend a $200 million loan to rescue the ailing airline.
